# Cenli DPE

> Cenli is a developer productivity engineering (DPE) platform that audits, refactors and gates AI-generated code before it reaches main.

Cenli sits between codegen agents and the main branch. It ingests every AI-authored commit, traces agent loops and tool calls, scores the result with an LLM-as-judge against a strict-modular policy bundle, and exposes human-in-the-loop overrides for refactor decisions.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, workflow and platform features.
- [About](/about): Mission and architecture behind the control plane for AI code.
- [Sign in](/auth): Authenticate to access the DPE workspace.
